name: Dove Turtle
overview: The dove and turtledove hold significant roles in Scripture as symbols of peace, purity, and sacrifice. In Genesis 8, Noah sent out a dove from the ark to test the receding floodwaters, and its return with an olive leaf assured the abatement of the waters. Additionally, Leviticus 1:14 prescribes turtledoves as acceptable burnt offerings, highlighting their role in purification and atonement practices. These birds also symbolize gentleness and the Holy Spirit, reflecting Christ's character and divine presence.
